text:
Residents:
Yuki (50s, WFH): Weekdays 9:00-17:30 at desk_b1. Often out for lunch. Hobbies: gym, running, friends.
Nora (40s, Office): Weekdays out ~8:00-17:30. Home evenings. Hobbies: napping, reading, sketching. Cares for dog.
*Note: Thursday was an exception; Nora was home sick all day.*

Object Locations & Movements:
Static Items:
- Balcony: Watering can on floor.
- Bathroom: Razor on sink; towels on rack.
- Bedroom 1 (Yuki): Desk has laptop, pen. Nightstand has book, tablet, charger. Wardrobe empty.
- Bedroom 2 (Nora): Desk has pencil case, sketchbook. Nightstand has book.
- Entry: Doormat, vacuum on floor. Hat on hook. Running shoes on rack.
- Kitchen: Dog bowl on floor.
- Living: Standard furniture items.

Dynamic Items (Thursday Update):
At 00:00, both residents home. Kitchen items (knife, pan, pot, spatula) moved from counter to drawers/cupboards. Mugs and glasses moved to sink. Yuki’s phone appeared on nightstand_b1.
At 08:00, Nora left for work (despite being sick, she took items out). Taken OUT_OF_HOUSE: dog_leash, jacket, keys, phone, shoes. Yuki’s phone also gone (likely taken by Yuki or left with Nora? Patrol says Yuki home, but phone gone. Assume Yuki took it or it was with Nora).
At 12:00, Nora returned home early (sick). Items returned: dog_leash, jacket, keys, shoes. Nora’s laptop, mug, water bottle, and book moved to coffee_table_l1. Yuki’s tablet moved to kitchen_table_k1.
At 16:00, Yuki’s water bottle moved from sink to desk_b1.
At 20:00, Evening routine. Blanket and book moved to couch_l1. Yuki’s charger to nightstand. Nora’s laptop to tv_stand_l1. Plates, glasses, water bottles moved to kitchen_table_k1. Yuki’s shoes to entry_floor. Keys to hook.

Current Status (Thu 23:59):
- Yuki: Home. Items in usual spots.
- Nora: Home (sick). Items in usual spots.
- Dog: Home.

Notes:
- Yuki’s routine: Takes gym bag, running shoes, jacket, umbrella, keys, wallet, water bottle when leaving for exercise.
- Nora’s routine: Takes work items (laptop, backpack, lunchbox, etc.) to office. Returns in evening.
- Thursday Exception: Nora stayed home sick. She took her work items out at 08:00 but returned at 12:00. This suggests she may have gone to the office briefly or the "out" status was a misinterpretation of her leaving the house for a short errand/doctor visit, or she simply went out and came back. Given she is "home sick," the 08:00-12:00 absence is unusual. It is possible she went to a doctor or pharmacy.
- Dog leash: Shared. Taken out by Yuki on Wed, Nora on Thu (08:00).
- Phone: Yuki’s phone was missing 08:00-12:00. Likely taken by Yuki for lunch/errand or with Nora.
